scope: Independent code review and rerun of the worker exact-indexed-triangle replay, plus separately recalculated rectangle inequalities. This is not a second independent deformation implementation or real-time playback.
reviewed_algorithm: Actual indexed vertex positions are transformed to world space before projection.
Above-floor clipping uses ordered triangle edges and exact y0 intersections; opposite sign guarantees a nonzero denominator.
The stage floor is opaque at y0 and200m wide, covering this bounded fixture.
Reused effect shaders alter fragments, not vertex positions; no hidden GPU displacement invalidates these bounds.
interpretation: Empty projected corners of enclosing AABBs overestimate actual geometry. All full actual indexed geometry already fits575px; clipping at the opaque floor further tightens bounds. Floor occlusion is not the sole or necessary explanation of conservative failure.
